string-array.name: moon_egg_lines
string-array.item: The moon has been watching your firmwares boot. It is very proud.
Somewhere in this valley, a Gingerbread phone is still optimizing apps.
Full moon reached. Your emulator now runs 0% faster, but feels 100% calmer.
Shh… the old Androids are sleeping under the stars.
You found the secret valley. Tell no one. (Or tell everyone.)
